title: When God goes silent, He’s not ignoring you — He’s preparing you.
paragraphs:
When God goes silent, He’s not ignoring you — He’s preparing you.
Your quiet season is not punishment. It’s positioning.
Stay faithful. Your impact is about to echo louder than you’ve ever imagined.
“Be still, and know that I am God.” — Psalm 46:10 (KJV)
